entry.title: Panhandle Gap (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Mount Rainier cannot be seen from Panhandle Gap (pictured), despite the trail being "possibly the best day hike" in Mount Rainier National Park?

entry.title: Marcia Moore (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that despite her father wanting her to become a music teacher, Marcia Moore ran away to Chicago to star in silent film, vaudeville, cabaret, and burlesque performances?

entry.title: al-Shaykh Badr (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that al-Shaykh Badr was the hometown of Salih al-Ali, who led the Alawite revolt against the French in Syria?

entry.title: Henry Smith (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a charity founded by Henry Smith in 1628 now has assets of more than £1 billion?

entry.title: 2024 Talerddig train collision (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the 2024 Talerddig train collision was the first collision between passenger trains in Wales since 1991?

entry.title: New World Mall (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that New World Mall was the largest Asian shopping mall in the Northeastern United States upon its opening in 2011?

entry.title: Your Girl (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Mariah Carey used a sample from the New Zealand duo Adeaze in her 2005 song "Your Girl"?

entry.title: Derrick Harden (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that working at a post office was how Derrick Harden became an NFL player?
